author: blu
body: Proves The Hive: "{3}, {T}: Create a 1/1 colourless Insect artifact creature token with flying named Wasp." compiles to an activated ability with the MakeInsectToken effect, and the tap-AI fires it in the main phase whenever it has the mana. The token is a real battlefield permanent: its 1/1-flying creature template is appended to the game's template table on the fly and the new permanent references it, so combat, blocking, and state-based actions treat the Wasp like any creature. Here the AI has 3 colourless mana and an untapped Hive; after ai-activate-taps a summoning-sick flying Wasp is on the battlefield, the Hive is tapped, and the mana is spent.
